enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Glass Shards: This weapon is made of fragile glass and will shatter on impact, inflicting a bleed effect on targets vulnerable to bleeding. This bleed deals 5d10 damage per stack every two seconds, lasts for 20 seconds, and can stack up to 15 times.
Keen: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.

Sovereign Disruption: On Hit: 4 to 24 Bane damage to Undead.On Vorpal Hit: If an undead struck by this weapon has fewer than 3000 Hit Points, it is instantly slain. If the undead has above 3000 Hit Points, it takes 300 damage.
Hemorrhaging: This weapon is viciously sharp and will do an additional 2 to 16 damage to targets that are vulnerable to bleeding.
Returning: This missile will return to you.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
